jobs.title: Professional Opportunity Listing
jobs.description: Professional opportunity listings published by advertisers in Saudi Arabia and moderated before public visibility

company.description: Advertiser, company, store or employer name

city.description: Saudi city stated in the listing

salary.description: Salary information stated by the advertiser

sponsorshipTransfer.description: Whether the advertiser states that service transfer may be handled through official procedures

accommodationProvided.description: Whether accommodation is stated as provided by the advertiser

transportationProvided.description: Whether transportation is stated as provided

experienceYears.description: Experience information requested by the advertiser

userId.description: UID of the user who published the listing

userEmail.description: Legacy email field for the listing owner

candidates.title: User-Published Professional Profile
candidates.description: Professional profile published by its owner for optional direct contact according to privacy settings

iqamaStatus.description: Residence/work status selected from the allowed platform values; visitor/visit status is not supported

experienceYears.description: Years of experience in the field

phone.description: Profile owner's phone number stored according to the contact model

whatsapp.description: Profile owner's WhatsApp number stored according to the contact model

hasDriverLicense.description: Whether the profile owner states having a Saudi driving license

availableImmediately.description: Whether the profile owner states immediate availability

userId.description: UID of the user who owns the professional profile

/jobs/{jobId}.description: Moderated professional opportunity listings with direct advertiser contact

/candidates/{candidateId}.description: User-published professional profiles governed by visibility and contact settings
